author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be serious pressure faced by the companies making life for all of us more expensive than it has to be. This was already an unsustainable business but a bunch of tech bros have accelerated the money burn to the point that these companies are starting to crack. Thanks for watching!

title: The AI Bubble Is Getting Worse Faster Than Expected...
